title: HiViS: Hiding Visual Tokens from the Drafter for Speculative Decoding in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2509.23928v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding has proven effective for accelerating inference in Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its extension to Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remains limited by the computational burden and semantic inconsistency introduced by visual tokens. Recent studies reveal that visual tokens in large VLMs are highly redundant, and most of them can be removed without compromising generation quality. Motivated by this observation, we propose HiViS (Hiding Visual Tokens from the Drafter for Speculative Decoding in Vision-Language Models), a framework that utilizes the target VLM as a semantic fusion model, allowing the drafter to obtain visual information without explicitly processing visual tokens, ensuring that the drafter's prefill sequence length matches that of the textual tokens. translated_title: HiViS：在视觉语言模型的推测解码中向草稿模型隐藏视觉令牌
translated_abstract: 推测解码已被证明能有效加速大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理，但其在视觉语言模型（VLMs）中的扩展仍受到视觉令牌带来的计算负担和语义不一致性的限制。近期研究表明，大型VLM中的视觉令牌高度冗余，大部分可以在不影响生成质量的情况下被移除。基于这一观察，我们提出了HiViS（在视觉语言模型的推测解码中向草稿模型隐藏视觉令牌）框架，该框架利用目标VLM作为语义融合模型，使草稿模型无需显式处理视觉令牌即可获取视觉信息，从而确保草稿模型的预填充序列长度与文本令牌匹配。此外，HiViS采用时间步感知的对齐训练方案，使草稿模型能够自主传播和优化指导性视觉信息。
tldr: HiViS通过隐藏视觉令牌并利用目标VLM进行语义融合，使草稿模型仅处理文本令牌，同时结合时间步感知训练，显著加速VLM推测解码而不牺牲生成质量。
en_tdlr: HiViS hides visual tokens and leverages the target VLM for semantic fusion, enabling the drafter to process only text tokens, while incorporating time-step-aware training to significantly accelerate speculative decoding in VLMs without sacrificing generation quality.
